title: Electricity use in homes (U.S. Energy Information Administration)
authority_note: Primary/official US government statistics agency (EIA); data from Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS 2020).
claims: Average US household consumes about 10,500 kWh of electricity per year (excludes generation/delivery losses)
Use varies by region/housing type; South single-family detached homes consume most
Largest 2020 end-use shares: air conditioning 19%, space heating 12%, water heating 12%
89% of homes used AC in 2020 (vs 57% in 1980); central AC 27% (1980) to 67% (2020)
99% of homes have a refrigerator; 34% had two or more (2020)
draft_usage: Cited for the ~10,500 kWh/year average US household baseline used to translate GW/TWh into homes powered.
